# smc_custom_properties_profile (Resource)

This represents a Custom Properties Profile Element, which allows users to define custom properties and scripts for dynamic elements.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `comment` (String) An optional comment for the element. This field is not required.
- `custom_property` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_property))
- `id` (String) this attribute is the identifier of terraform resource
- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `type` (String) The type of the Custom Properties Profile, which can be 'azure' for Azure-specific profiles or 'custom' for customizable profiles.

### Read-Only

- `admin_domain` (String) This represents a Domain. Domains are administrative boundaries that allow you to separate the configuration details and other information in the system for the purpose of limiting administrator access.
- `etag` (String) The ETag of the element, used for versioning. This field is not required.
- `key` (Number) The unique identifier for the element. This field is required for updates but not for creation.
- `link` (Map of String) provides additional actions or resources.
- `locked` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is locked. This field is not required.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is read-only. This field is not required.
- `system` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is a System element. This field is not required.
- `system_key` (Number) The system key of the System element. This field is not required.
- `trashed` (Boolean) Indicates if the element is trashed. This field is not required.

<a id="nestedblock--custom_property"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_property`

Optional:

- `data_type` (String) The data type of the custom property, which can be 'string' for regular strings or 'encrypted' for encrypted values.
- `encrypted_value` (String) The encrypted value of the custom property, used for sensitive information such as passwords.
- `name` (String) The name of the custom property, which serves as the key in the key-value pair.
- `value` (String) The value of the custom property, which can be a regular string or an encrypted value.
